supersedes.schema: Nothing: purely additive (one new table week_food_contexts and five new functions). weeks, week_days, profiles, apply_week and update_week_slot are not redefined; no row is modified.
client: /api/generate-menu and /api/substitute-dish took the profile (restrictions, allergies) from the request body; now the server reads it with current_food_context() and ignores body.profile.
/api/generate-shopping-list assumed 2 people and received no restrictions; now it reads the week's frozen context with week_food_context_status().
Shopping signature with a constant context (2 people, no restrictions); now the week's frozen servings and restrictions version (legacy constant kept for weeks without a context).
supersedes.rollout: The previous client keeps applying weeks with this migration applied (no freeze: they read as weeks before C1). scripts/food-context-db-tests.cjs, scenario 9. Order: migration -> code.

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.food_context_version(p_restrictions jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE WHEN p_restrictions IS NULL THEN 'fc1:none' ELSE 'fc1:' || md5(p_restrictions::text) END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_food_context()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT coalesce((
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'found', true,
      'householdSize', p.household_size,
      'restrictions', r.restrictions,
      'version', public.food_context_version(r.restrictions),
      'preferences', jsonb_build_object(
        'goals', to_jsonb(p.goals),
        'otherGoal', coalesce(p.other_goal, ''),
        'weeklyTrainingDays', p.weekly_training_days,
        'trainingTypes', to_jsonb(p.training_types)),
      'updatedAt', p.updated_at)
    FROM public.profiles AS p
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT public.food_context_restrictions(
      p.dietary_restrictions, p.allergies, p.other_allergies, p.disliked_foods) AS restrictions) AS r
    WHERE p.user_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
    LIMIT 1
  ), jsonb_build_object('found', false));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.week_food_context_status(p_iso_year integer, p_iso_week integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  WITH week AS (
    SELECT w.id FROM public.weeks AS w
    WHERE w.user_id = (SELECT auth.uid()) AND w.iso_year = p_iso_year AND w.iso_week = p_iso_week
    LIMIT 1
  ), frozen AS (
    SELECT c.* FROM public.week_food_contexts AS c JOIN week ON week.id = c.week_id
  ), current_context AS (
    SELECT public.current_food_context() AS ctx
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'week', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM week),
    'frozen', (SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'servings', f.servings, 'servingsSource', f.servings_source, 'householdSize', f.household_size,
      'restrictions', f.restrictions, 'version', f.context_version, 'frozenAt', f.frozen_at)
      FROM frozen AS f),
    'current', (SELECT ctx - 'preferences' FROM current_context),
    'restrictionsChanged', coalesce((
      SELECT f.context_version IS DISTINCT FROM
        CASE WHEN (cc.ctx ->> 'found')::boolean THEN cc.ctx ->> 'version' ELSE 'fc1:none' END
      FROM frozen AS f, current_context AS cc), false),
    'householdChanged', coalesce((
      SELECT f.household_size IS NOT NULL AND (cc.ctx ->> 'found')::boolean
        AND f.household_size <> (cc.ctx ->> 'householdSize')::integer
      FROM frozen AS f, current_context AS cc), false)
  );
$function$
